clues.it: Anna era esattamente una riga a nord di Olga e da sola in Cabina.
clues.en: Anna was exactly one row north of Olga and alone in the Cabin.

clues.it: Olga era nella 7ª colonna, accanto a una rete e a una sedia, ma non era accanto a una cassa.
clues.en: Olga was in the 7th column, beside a net and a chair, but was not beside a crate.

clues.it: Nino era nella 3ª riga, accanto a una sedia e in una stanza diversa da Olga.
clues.en: Nino was in the 3rd row, beside a chair and in a different room from Olga.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da solo con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Bruno era accanto a uno scaffale e a ovest di Olga.
clues.en: Bruno was beside a shelf and west of Olga.

clues.it: Tea era nella 6ª riga, a ovest di Anna e da sola in Plancia.
clues.en: Tea was in the 6th row, west of Anna and alone on the Bridge.

clues.it: Elena era accanto a una sedia e a ovest di Tea.
clues.en: Elena was beside a chair and west of Tea.

clues.it: Marta era accanto a un'ancora e in una stanza diversa da Bruno.
clues.en: Marta was beside an anchor and in a different room from Bruno.

clues.it: Ugo era nella 4ª colonna e nella 9ª riga, ma non era accanto a una pianta.
clues.en: Ugo was in the 4th column and in the 9th row, but was not beside a plant.

general_clues.en: 4 in the west half of the grid.
4 in the north half of the grid.

steps.it: L'indizio di Olga lascia una sola casella libera: riga 2ª, colonna 7ª.
steps.en: Olga's own clue leaves a single free square: row 2nd, column 7th.

steps.it: L'indizio di Nino lascia una sola casella libera: riga 3ª, colonna 2ª.
steps.en: Nino's own clue leaves a single free square: row 3rd, column 2nd.

steps.it: L'indizio di Ugo lascia una sola casella libera: riga 9ª, colonna 4ª.
steps.en: Ugo's own clue leaves a single free square: row 9th, column 4th.

steps.it: Incrociando l'indizio di Anna con quelli già usati resta una sola casella: riga 1ª, colonna 9ª.
steps.en: Cross-checking Anna's clue with the ones already used leaves a single square: row 1st, column 9th.

steps.it: Incrociando l'indizio di Tea con quelli già usati resta una sola casella: riga 6ª, colonna 8ª.
steps.en: Cross-checking Tea's clue with the ones already used leaves a single square: row 6th, column 8th.

steps.it: Nino può stare solo nella 3ª riga: escludendola, a Bruno resta una sola casella: riga 5ª, colonna 1ª.
steps.en: Nino can only be in the 3rd row: ruling it out leaves Bruno a single square: row 5th, column 1st.

steps.it: Bruno può stare solo nella 5ª riga: escludendola, a Marta resta una sola casella: riga 8ª, colonna 6ª.
steps.en: Bruno can only be in the 5th row: ruling it out leaves Marta a single square: row 8th, column 6th.

steps.it: Tea può stare solo nella 6ª riga: escludendola, a Elena resta una sola casella: riga 7ª, colonna 5ª.
steps.en: Tea can only be in the 6th row: ruling it out leaves Elena a single square: row 7th, column 5th.

steps.it: Ugo può stare solo nella 4ª colonna: escludendola, a Luca resta una sola casella: riga 4ª, colonna 3ª.
steps.en: Ugo can only be in the 4th column: ruling it out leaves Luca a single square: row 4th, column 3rd.
